desc: Made in the U.S.A., the ADM Universal Improved Carbine (UIC) Mod 2 is built on a billet aluminum with fully ambidextrous upper and lower receiver set. The fully ambidextrous controls feature a right side bolt catch and release lever, and left side magazine release. The lower receiver also features an ambidextrous safety selector, 20 degree competition style mag well, and 2-Stage match trigger.
